departments.title: Reporting for High School
departments.description: Our High School Reporting team brings informative and interactive videos about current events to those in the 9th grade and above. They use skits, interview students and staff, and report to you what they—and hopefully, you—find interesting.
departments.leader_bio: Organizes script writing and makes sure the videographers are available to film scenes for the videos.

departments.title: Reporting for Middle & Elementary School
departments.description: The Middle and Elementary School Reporters plan to film fun videos that can get our middle/elementary students excited about current and upcoming events that the lower grades can participate in!
departments.leader_title: Head of Reporting for Middle & Elementary School
departments.leader_bio: Oversees script writing, topics, and recording times.

departments.title: Podcasts
departments.description: Our podcasters work hard to record episodes with discussions on various relevant topics. Look out for their weekly episodes on learning and mental disabilities!
departments.leader_bio: Makes script outlines, leads discussions, and keeps episodes on track.

departments.title: Photography & Videography
departments.description: The video and photographers are very crucial to our team, as they handle all of the filming for the many scenes and videos for Jaguar News. They make the reporters’ ideal scenes come to life and take pictures of important school events.
departments.leader_bio: Delegates photography shoots for school events and recording for the reporters.

departments.title: Writing
departments.description: Our writing department works hard to come up with articles about happenings both inside and outside of school to bring to those in all grade levels. They’ll write on things like fun facts, events that are happening during school, and awareness of certain topics.
departments.leader_bio: Edits and revises articles before pushing them out to the public.

departments.title: Website Design and Programming
departments.description: Our Design and Programming team is in charge of the website design and building. They maintain it and manage the content being published.
departments.leader_bio:
I am an avid photographer and traveler who always tries to take up a challenge. I made the website alongside the lead of design Kyleigh Murphy. I'm a longtime student at TLC and even plan to graduate early!
